record.question: State whether the following statements are true or false: (a) Government servants are allowed to take Mass Casual Leave/ mass abstention from work. (b) All government servants are required to maintain devotion to duty during office hours. (c) A Government servant is permissible to bring political or outside influence relating to his or her service matters under the Government. (d) A Government servant is permitted to marry a person having a living spouse. (e) "Public place" means any place or premises to which the public have, or are permitted to have, access, whether on payment or otherwise.
options: True or False for each statement
record.explanation: The statements can be evaluated as (a) False (mass casual leave/mass abstention is not permitted), (b) True (devotion to duty is required), (c) False (outside/political influence in service matters is prohibited), (d) False (marriage to a person with a living spouse is generally prohibited), and (e) True (this is the standard definition of public place). However, the supplied options contain only a generic instruction and blank entries, so the corresponding answer choice cannot be mapped defensibly.
